newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST - Italy mkt sees o/n rate fall, 1 month view.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Italy mkt sees o/n rate fall, 1 month view.

text.p: Italy's money market sees a fall in the overnight rate on a one month horizon but uncertainty over the current interest rate trend continues, said a study by Milan's Bocconi University research arm Igier on Friday.

The market sees the implicit overnight rate falling to 7.30 percent on a one month horizon against 7.42 percent seen a week ago, and an actual market close of 7.5 percent on Thursday -- the day on which Igier based its study.
On a three month timeframe the implicit overnight rate is seen at 6.97 percent from 6.99 percent seen a week ago, but sharply up from the 6.73 percent seen one month ago.

On a one year horizon, the implicit overnight rate is seen at 6.39 percent, up from 6.2 percent seen a week ago and from 5.8 percent a month ago. On a two year horizon, the market sees the implicit overnight rate at 6.62 percent from 6.47 percent last week and 6.05 percent one month ago.

The spread between the Italian implicit overnight rate and the German implicit overnight rate, seen as a good indicator of market confidence in Italy's chances of membership in Europe's economic and monetary union, today stands at 223 basis points from 212 bps a week ago and sharply higher than 151 pbs a month ago.
